mapper.sql: id, diary_id, page_date, page_order, background_type, paper_color, page_header, page_header_font, page_header_bold, content, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM diary_pages WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} ORDER BY page_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary_pages ( diary_id, page_date, page_order, background_type, paper_color, page_header, content, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{diaryId}, #{pageDate}, #{pageOrder}, #{backgroundType}, #{paperColor}, #{pageHeader}, #{content}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE diary_pages SET page_date = #{pageDate}, page_order = #{pageOrder}, background_type = #{backgroundType}, paper_color = #{paperColor}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND diary_id = #{diaryId}
UPDATE diary_pages SET page_header = #{pageHeader}, page_header_font = #{pageHeaderFont}, page_header_bold = #{pageHeaderBold}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{pageId} AND diary_id = #{diaryId}
